chunks: We sent Noah to his people, and he said: "O people worship God; you have no other god but He; for I fear the retribution of the great Day may fall on you."
ai.seo_question: What was Noah's main message to his people according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the foundational principle of *Tawhid* (monotheism) as the primary duty of all prophets, with Noah serving as the archetype of divine warning (*Nadhir*). The phrase 'what is there for you of a god other than Him' emphasizes the negation of false deities (*Nafi*) to establish the uniqueness of Allah, a theme central to Imam Ali’s sermons in *Nahj al-Balagha*. This call to worship is immediately coupled with the fear of a 'great day,' linking immediate belief to eschatological accountability.
